companyDescription: Extended-release local steroid (Diffusphere™) · EP-104GI, a single-procedure esophageal injection for eosinophilic esophagitis — Phase 2b RESOLVE placebo-controlled interim due December 2026
priceNote: Live $7.63 (+10.9%) on Nov 11, 2026, a day after Q3 results reconfirmed the December interim. The 52-week range is $5.63–$9.32. Market cap is ~$500M (~66M shares). A US$125M ATM program with Jefferies was set up on Nov 10.
summary: The binary is the December 2026 interim from the placebo-controlled Phase 2b part of RESOLVE: 120 patients randomized 1:1:1 to 120mg, 160mg or vehicle, fully enrolled Oct 12. Open-label Phase 1b/2a showed remission of 59% at 12 weeks and up to 76% at 24 weeks with no treatment-related SAEs. A one-time local injection would be a very different product from daily or biweekly EoE therapy. Consensus is ~$17 (Stifel $25). Runway reaches 2H 2028 even before the new $125M ATM, so there is no survival flag, but the ATM is a live dilution overhang into the print. Base +70% (~$13) assumes a clean placebo separation and a 1–2 month re-rating toward consensus. That is above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp), so it is a post-data horizon. แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–80%.

catalysts.name: RESOLVE Phase 2b interim (placebo-controlled) — EP-104GI in EoE
catalysts.description: 120 patients (120mg / 160mg / vehicle, 1:1:1), enrollment complete Oct 12, 2026. Company reconfirmed a December 2026 interim in its Nov 10 Q3 release. Histology plus symptom (dysphagia) separation vs vehicle is the bar.

risks: EoE trials can hit histology and still miss symptoms. Allakos hit its histologic co-primaries but missed the symptom endpoints and fell ~88% (Dec 2021).
A new US$125M ATM (Nov 10) gives the company a way to sell into any pre-data strength.
The open-label Phase 1b/2a cohorts were tiny (the high-dose group was n=3), so placebo-controlled data may shrink the effect.
Competitive market: Dupixent is entrenched in EoE, and oral and biologic entrants keep raising the bar.
"December" has no exact day, and an interim (not final) readout invites a "wait for full data" discount.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Clinical-stage GI biotech. The RESOLVE interim dominates. Rates matter through small-cap biotech multiples and the ATM sale price.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the December hike is priced. The Dec 9 FOMC and Dec 10 CPI land right inside the readout window, so pre-data volatility is likely.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2.5% max — a dated December placebo-controlled read on a differentiated one-shot EoE product, funded to 2H28. The new ATM and today's +11% pop argue for waiting. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: EPRX popped +11% on Nov 11 after Q3 reconfirmed the December timing. Small caps with a dated controlled readout often drift up into it, but the ATM will supply stock into strength.

postWin.note: MDGL rose ~268% in a day on a clean Phase 3 (Dec 2022), the top-decile shape. A Phase 2b interim on a mid-size indication more realistically re-rates +30–100% toward the ~$17 consensus.

postLose.note: ALLK fell ~88% when its EoE program hit histology but missed symptoms (Dec 2021). CMPS fell ~36% on a technically positive but underwhelming Phase 3 (Jun 2025).

spotSizing.reason: 2.5%. There is no n≥5 bucket for this type, so the lane-wide prior governs (hitRate 4.9%, medianExcess +2.0pp). It is trimmed further for the live ATM overhang and an interim (not final) readout.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If either dose fails to separate on symptoms, exit day 1 (ALLK precedent).

The open-label data barely moved the stock (~+5%). The market is waiting for placebo control, which is why the December interim is the real binary.

th.summary: ตัวชี้ขาดคือผลระหว่างทางเดือน ธ.ค. 2026 ของ RESOLVE ส่วน Phase 2b แบบมีกลุ่มยาหลอก: 120 ราย สุ่ม 1:1:1 ไปที่ 120mg, 160mg หรือ vehicle รับครบ 12 ต.ค. ช่วง Phase 1b/2a แบบ open-label มี remission 59% ที่ 12 สัปดาห์ และสูงสุด 76% ที่ 24 สัปดาห์ โดยไม่มี SAE ที่เกี่ยวกับยา การฉีดเฉพาะที่ครั้งเดียวจะเป็นผลิตภัณฑ์ที่ต่างจากยา EoE ที่ใช้ทุกวันหรือทุกสองสัปดาห์มาก consensus ~$17 (Stifel $25) เงินพอถึงครึ่งหลังปี 2028 แม้ไม่นับ ATM $125M ใหม่ จึงไม่ติด survival flag แต่ ATM ยังเป็นแรงกดจากการเพิ่มทุนก่อนผล Base +70% (~$13) สมมติว่าแยกจากยาหลอกได้ชัดและ re-rate ไปหา consensus ใน 1–2 เดือน สูงกว่า P75 30 วันจริงของกลุ่ม (+12.2%; bias +72.7pp) จึงเป็นกรอบเวลาหลังผล แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–80%
